question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class `agents.setDefault` Gateway RPC/API surface for external clients, or keep default-agent changes behind the existing config mutation path plus the built-in UI helper?
rationale: The missing behavior is real, but the fix is a new public operator-admin Gateway/protocol/SDK/admin HTTP write contract, and the previous implementation was closed unmerged for lack of explicit maintainer sponsorship.

options.title: Sponsor the RPC
options.body: Approve a focused additive API PR using the prior implementation shape, with compatibility review across protocol, SDK, admin HTTP, docs, and tests.

options.title: Keep config writes only
options.body: Decline the new RPC surface and document `config.set` or `config.patch` as the supported external-client path for default-agent changes.

options.title: Defer agent API design
options.body: Keep the product need open only if maintainers want to redesign agent-management mutations together rather than adding this one method.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the RPC
recommendation.body: Approve a focused additive API PR using the prior implementation shape, with compatibility review across protocol, SDK, admin HTTP, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and prepared the original Gateway agent CRUD method family, so they are the best available owner for the method-family API direction.
